about: Every build input, pinned by SHA-256. The build reads only these files, refuses any that differ, and never reads /usr/share/dict, the network or a live repository (docs/plan/12, Inputs).

inputs.name: scowl
inputs.license: SCOWL collective permissive notice plus component notices (scowl-2020.12.07/Copyright in the archive; shipped verbatim as licenses/SCOWL-Copyright)
inputs.use: English and American words at levels 10-20 are the correction targets; every final/ list is the real-word guard for generated keys; any list at levels up to 80 vetoes an authored key and is the reverse-ambiguity guard; abbreviation lists are protected

inputs.name: web2
inputs.license: public domain: web2-README says the 1934 copyright of Webster's Second International has lapsed
inputs.use: real-word guard for generated keys only (a generated key that is a word here is dropped); never a correction source. Frozen copy of the system dictionary round 7 read, so Linux and macOS builds agree

inputs.name: project-terms
inputs.version: round 6 vocabulary caches: codex 89461ea6, opencode ba06ff9e, pi 2ec55d80, typos 7f9d0819
inputs.license: lowercase word tokens of identifiers and paths in Apache-2.0 / MIT code (openai/codex, sst/opencode, badlogic/pi-mono, crate-ci/typos source files, not its dictionaries); a subtraction-only guard, never shipped
inputs.use: protected project terms: a key equal to one is dropped, and each counts as a level-35 word for reverse ambiguity. Frozen from experiments/vocab/data/*.cache.json by `murmo-lang-en freeze-project-terms`

inputs.name: programming-terms
inputs.use: hand-listed extensions, tools and abbreviations (json, npm, stdin, ...); protected like project terms

inputs.name: base-vetoes
inputs.use: generated keys dropped by hand review, each with its reason

inputs.name: authored
inputs.version: round 8 author draft, frozen 2026-10-19 before any public typo list was read
inputs.license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT (Murmo): written from general knowledge, not copied or derived from any list
inputs.use: hand-written common typos (`typo correction category` per line); kept lines are deliberate exceptions to the generated base's filters

inputs.name: authored-review
inputs.use: authored lines rejected by hand review, corrections allowed although no word list has them, and notes for the lowercase-only exceptions

inputs.name: case-policy
inputs.use: keys that correct only in lowercase; shipped unchanged as the pack's case-policy.json

inputs.name: inline-overrides
inputs.use: the two round-12 engine mappings the reviewed list lacked (wich, i); added last and never allowed to replace an entry
